raised.comment: Lifts an element above its siblings inside its own stacking context, such as a control layered over a card.

sticky.comment: Sticky headers and pinned columns within the page flow.

dropdown.comment: In-flow menus that stay inside their container rather than portaling to the body.

overlay.comment: In-page overlays such as drawers and scrims that cover page chrome but not dialogs.

modal.comment: Dialog backdrop and frame. High enough to clear any page chrome an application stacks with its own numbers.

popover.comment: Floating panels portaled to the body (Select menus, Popover, date pickers). Above modal because they are routinely opened from inside a dialog, and a panel under the backdrop is hidden and swallows clicks.

toast.comment: Top of the stack. A toast reports the outcome of what somebody just did, often in a dialog or from a menu opened inside one, so it sits above both.
